description.text: Objectives Objective of the undergraduate program in E-Commerce aims to enhance students’ ability in management, communication, E-Commerce system Planning, and Analysis and Design. The program includes subjects in the areas of management, trade, finance, marketing, computer network technology, modern business and management, law, trade principles, as well as Chinese trade relations with neighboring regions. Graduates from the program will have a good employment opportunity in companies and government agencies involved in trades with China. Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice. Degree Awarded A bachelor degree in economics is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation. Main Courses Principles of Management, Principles of Economics, E-Commerce Database Technology, E-Commerce Development Technology, E-Commerce System Analysis and Design, E-Commerce Website Construction, Electronic Payment and Network Finance, E-Commerce Logistics Management, Network Marketing and Planning, E-Commerce Laws and Regulations. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The E-Commerce at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
